ckb.serverUrl.description: CKB Reality server used for local/static/runtime intelligence. A remote server cannot read local filesystem paths unless the project was scanned through a supported remote source flow.

ckb.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key sent as `X-API-Key` only to the configured `ckb.serverUrl`. A `ckb_live_` key can also be used as the guarded-change Cloud fallback; direct guarded-change entry stores Cloud keys in VS Code SecretStorage.

ckb.runtimeProjectId.description: Optional Reality Engine project id used only for runtime/traces polling. Leave blank for the current/default project on a local CKB server.

ckb.liveRuntimePolling.description: Continuously refresh evidence-backed runtime/traces in Invisible Reality. Static relations are never animated as runtime.

ckb.runtimePollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval while exact Live Reality evidence is available. Offline/waiting states automatically back off.

ckb.runtimeRequestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for runtime/traces reads from the configured CKB Reality server.

ckb.editorSemanticReality.description: Enable cursor-driven semantic editor reality. CKB derives LINE/CALL/SYMBOL/FILE/SUBSYSTEM/SYSTEM depth from selection and visible editor scale, and only highlights runtime when exact observed trace evidence maps to the current source.

ckb.cloudApiUrl.description: Authenticated CKB Cloud API used for Raiziom evidence, model-neutral context compilation, verified frontier-model compatibility metadata and guarded transactions. Source contents and absolute local filesystem paths are not uploaded by this client; selected relative architecture identifiers/coordinates may be sent as context.

ckb.cloudProjectId.description: CKB Cloud project identity used by in-IDE architecture intelligence, Raiziom and guarded-change requests. It must match the Cloud project whose architecture evidence should be authoritative.

ckb.cliBinary.description: Executable name/path for the standard CKB CLI.

ckb.intelligenceBinary.description: Executable name/path for the high-performance CKB IDE intelligence facade.

ckb.causalityBinary.description: Executable name/path for the V13.1 Deep Software Causality CLI used to build local evidence bundles and run data-flow, taint, schema, infrastructure, concurrency, temporal, ownership and change-simulation intelligence.

ckb.analysisTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of a local deep architecture analysis or CKB server request.

ckb.autoScanOnOpen.description: Hydrate Invisible Reality shortly after a workspace opens.

ckb.rescanOnSave.description: Coalesce source-file changes and refresh architecture intelligence after editing activity settles.

ckb.rescanDebounceMs.description: Quiet period used to coalesce rapid file changes into one analysis pass.

ckb.deepAnalysisOnSave.description: Refresh deep activity + architecture memory after the debounced save/change window.

ckb.showDiagnostics.description: Show evidence-backed architecture findings as inline diagnostics.

ckb.productGuidance.description: Show first-run reveal guidance and one-time evidence-backed milestones. Disable for a completely silent product experience.

ckb.cloudExplorerUrl.description: Cloud Project Explorer opened from the Invisible Reality cockpit and cursor continuity actions.
